title: MCP File Exchange Extension
description: Normative wire schema for the MCP File Exchange Extension, version 0.1. Targets MCP revision 2025-11-25. schema/file-exchange.ts is an informative TypeScript companion.

FileExchangeCapability.description: Value placed at capabilities.experimental["nl.liesdonk.file-exchange"]. Open to unknown fields for forward compatibility (spec section 17.2).

version.description: Extension version implemented by the server.

roles.description: Transports supported per role. A role not played is omitted.

digests.description: Digest algorithms supported. Defaults to ["sha-256"] when absent.

maxArtifactSize.description: Largest artifact in bytes the server will produce or accept. Advisory.

PullTransport.description: A transport for the provider/fetcher (pull) roles. Defined values: "filesystem", "download". The set is open (spec section 17.5); an unrecognized value is permitted so a later version can add transports.

PushTransport.description: A transport for the receiver/sender (push) roles. Defined values: "filesystem", "upload". The set is open (spec section 17.5); an unrecognized value is permitted so a later version can add transports.

ArtifactMetadata.description: Describes an artifact independently of how it is transferred. Open to unknown fields for forward compatibility (spec section 17.2).

id.description: Stable identifier for the artifact, opaque to consumers.

name.description: Human-readable name. For display only; not a filesystem path.

ArtifactConstraints.description: Constraints a receiver imposes on an artifact it will accept. Open to unknown fields for forward compatibility (spec section 17.2).

maxSize.description: Maximum acceptable artifact size in bytes.

acceptMimeTypes.description: Acceptable media types; entries may be "type/*" patterns.

requireDigest.description: Digest algorithms the receiver requires; if present the sender MUST send a matching Content-Digest header (RFC 9530). When present this array MUST be non-empty.

FilesystemSource.description: Source descriptor: read an artifact from a shared filesystem location.

uri.description: Locator URI: exchange://<volume>/<path> (volume-anchored, resolved per-party; non-empty volume and path required) or a file:///<absolute-path> URI (empty authority — no remote host — identical-mount-namespace only). Consumers MUST canonicalize and confine the resolved path at runtime (spec section 10.1.3).

DownloadSource.description: Source descriptor: read an artifact via a one-time HTTPS download URL.

url.description: https:// capability URL retrievable with an unauthenticated GET.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which the URL must be rejected.

singleUse.description: If true, the URL is invalidated after a complete retrieval.

UnknownTransportDescriptor.description: Fallthrough branch for a transport this schema version does not define. Requires only a transport name; a consumer skips such a descriptor during selection (spec section 9). The known transport names are excluded so a known-but-malformed descriptor still fails against its own branch.
UnknownTransportDescriptor.$comment: The not/enum exclusion list must name every transport used as a `transport` const by a defined descriptor (FilesystemSource, DownloadSource, FilesystemSink, UploadSink). A future version that adds a transport descriptor must add that transport name here, or a malformed instance of the new descriptor could match this fallthrough branch.

TransferSource.description: A descriptor for reading an artifact's bytes. The transport set is open (spec section 17.5): a descriptor with an unrecognized transport validates via the unknown-transport branch and is skipped during selection (spec section 9).

FilesystemSink.description: Sink descriptor: write an artifact to a shared filesystem location.

uri.description: Locator URI at which the artifact is to be written: exchange://<volume>/<path> (non-empty volume and path required) or a file:///<absolute-path> URI (empty authority — no remote host). Consumers MUST canonicalize and confine the resolved path at runtime (spec section 10.1.3).

UploadSink.description: Sink descriptor: write an artifact via an HTTPS upload URL. Upload URLs are implicitly single-use (spec section 10.3); unlike DownloadSource there is no singleUse flag.

url.description: https:// capability URL the artifact is sent to.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which the URL must be rejected.

TransferSink.description: A descriptor for writing an artifact's bytes. The transport set is open (spec section 17.5): a descriptor with an unrecognized transport validates via the unknown-transport branch and is skipped during selection (spec section 9).

TransferHandle.description: A pull token: an artifact plus one or more ways to read it. Open to unknown fields for forward compatibility (spec section 17.2).

sources.description: Source descriptors, ordered by provider preference.

requires.description: Feature identifiers a consumer MUST understand to process this reference (spec section 17.4). A consumer that does not recognize every entry MUST reject the reference with an unsupported-requirement error. A reference whose `version` is `0.1` MUST omit this field or leave it empty; this schema enforces that.

IntakeTicket.description: A push token: one or more ways to write an artifact to a receiver. Open to unknown fields for forward compatibility (spec section 17.2).

artifactId.description: Receiver-chosen correlation identifier for the pushed artifact.

sinks.description: Sink descriptors, ordered by receiver preference.

requires.description: Feature identifiers a consumer MUST understand to process this reference (spec section 17.4). A consumer that does not recognize every entry MUST reject the reference with an unsupported-requirement error. A reference whose `version` is `0.1` MUST omit this field or leave it empty; this schema enforces that.

TransferErrorCode.description: Machine-readable transfer failure reason. Defined values: no-supported-transport, descriptor-expired, not-accessible, digest-mismatch, size-mismatch, too-large, mime-type-rejected, unsupported-requirement, transfer-failed. The set is open (spec section 13); an unrecognized code is treated as a generic failure.

TransferError.description: Placed at _meta["nl.liesdonk.file-exchange/error"] of a failed transfer's CallToolResult. Open to unknown fields for forward compatibility (spec section 17.2).

transport.description: The transport that was attempted, when applicable. Defined values: filesystem, download, upload. Open for forward compatibility.
